course.ncvtBody: This is an NCVT trade. Its syllabus is set nationally by DGT, so the state cannot rewrite it. What the ITI can do is add a short add-on module, and the state can send DGT or the Sector Skill Council a formal recommendation with this evidence attached.
course.stateBody: State and short-term courses can be changed by their owners: the state board approves changes to MSSDS/MSBSVET courses. NCVT trades are different: their syllabus is set nationally by DGT, so for those we propose add-on modules or send a recommendation.
